correctness.rationale: Rotating to the unique zero 5-mer gives one representative per oriented cycle. A separate exhaustive enumeration prescribes the last exit at each nonroot vertex of the binary order-four graph, accepts the assignments whose last exits reach the root, then uses the other exit first and starts at the zero edge. In a tour last-exit times increase toward the root; conversely this condition prevents the ordered walk stopping short, since any vertex with an unused exit would lead via unused last exits to the exhausted root. The test gave 2048 distinct valid representatives. Integer masks and reflected half bits checked each allowed circular window of lengths 1–32, with distinctness tracked by length and value. The complete spectrum and all 51 profile rows match the frozen CSVs; exact mean 1775/64 and variance 12511/4096 match. Normalized reversal/complement gives the tabulated row-wise orbit decomposition, totaling 32 size-2 and 496 size-4 orbits. The two examples each have longest length 7 and totals 22 and 23, respectively. The fixed short-length contribution 20 follows from coverage of every 5-mer.
residual_risks: Exhaustive at order five; no inference to a distribution at higher order.

originality.rationale: A distinct indexed joint census explicitly states the same seven-cell histogram and 51 length profiles, on the identical 2048 rotation classes. Its cycle-level data determine the remaining orbit columns and witnesses without further factor enumeration. This is demonstrable comparison coverage, not a finding that the later-dated catalogue item predates the frozen one or that either was derived from the other. No independently distinct claim remains by narrowing this result to the reported orbit refinement.
residual_risks: Historical priority and relationship between the dated records remain unresolved; neither is inferred from the catalogue dates.
The Simpson full text and unindexed material could show additional historical overlap; they do not drive the failure decision.

value.rationale: The distribution is a natural exact invariant and the distinction between longest and total is meaningful, but the exact joint census on the same mathematical domain already gives the salient scientific information. Means, example comparisons and symmetry columns are read-offs or simple grouping of that existing table. A reproduced census without a distinct remaining question is not a new valuable finding under this review.
residual_risks: This decision concerns additional scientific content, not the worth of the census as an underlying combinatorial result or the provenance of either record.
